name: copy_table_byte_twice
description: Reads one byte from a table at an offset built from the data register and the state base, then stores that same byte into two adjacent slots of the state block.

name: lookup_byte_via_swapped_word
description: Byte-swaps a stored word, adds a fixed base and the low byte of an index register, and returns the byte found at that computed table address.

name: split_high_bytes_into_positions
description: Copies the high byte of one stored word into a first position word, and copies the high byte of a second word into another position word, sign-extending it when it exceeds 199.

name: split_number_into_decimal_digits
description: Divides the input value by one hundred and then by ten, sending each digit to a helper routine and suppressing a leading hundreds or tens digit that is zero.

name: adjust_position_by_key_code
description: Masks a key code to seven bits and stores it, then adds fixed signed steps to a horizontal position word for selected codes such as space, letters and a few punctuation keys. If the new position is within limits it refreshes a pointer and calls helpers.

name: swap_buffers_and_set_bitplanes
description: Alternates two stored screen buffer pointers, writes the chosen buffer address into four bitplane pointer slots spaced 8000 bytes apart, and writes the DMA control register to enable DMA.

name: convert_longwords_to_bitplanes
description: Converts a block of source longwords into four bitplanes. For each output column it gathers one bit from every source longword into four 16-bit accumulators and stores each accumulator into its own plane.

name: reset_position_and_copy
description: Sets a position word to zero and another to a fixed value, runs helper calls driven by a low nibble count, then copies a 60-longword strip from the displayed buffer into the back buffer across four planes.

name: draw_rows_then_copy_strip
description: Runs a counted sequence of helper calls, then copies a 60-longword strip from the displayed buffer into the back buffer across four bitplanes.

name: repeat_helper_until_break
description: Repeats a helper call in a loop that can exit early on a counter, then runs a second counted helper loop and copies a 60-longword strip into the back buffer.

name: call_helper_then_copy_strip
description: Calls a helper once per iteration of a counted loop, then copies a 60-longword strip from the displayed buffer into the back buffer across four bitplanes.

name: setup_sprite_record_at_position
description: Fills a small control record with a code, a fixed type value, offsets derived from the stored horizontal and vertical position words, and fixed limit values of 160 and 200, then calls a helper.

name: clear_playfield_block
description: Resets two position words to fixed values and zeroes a block of 128 rows by eight longwords in four planes of the display buffer, starting at a fixed offset.

name: copy_frame_after_dispatch
description: Stores a relative pointer to the back buffer in a control record, makes two indirect calls through computed addresses, then copies 8000 longwords from the first buffer pointer into the second.

name: read_and_clear_pending_flag
description: Returns the byte stored at a flag location and resets the two-byte flag word to zero, so each flag value is consumed once.

name: wait_for_flag_then_clear
description: Spins until the flag byte becomes non-zero, then clears the flag word and returns the flag value.

name: write_masked_words_to_record
description: Uses a stored index to select a record in a table, then writes two stored words, each masked to its upper byte, into two fields of that record.

name: set_index_return_stored_word
description: Stores an index word and clears a second word in the control block, makes two helper calls, and returns a word read from another slot combined with the input value.

name: select_record_pointer_from_table
description: Takes an index, reads a big-endian longword from a pointer table, converts it to an address relative to the state base, and stores it as the current record address.

name: load_next_table_entry_fields
description: Reads an eight-byte table entry at the current index and loads three big-endian words from it into control fields, then follows a relative offset to a second entry and loads four byte fields from that entry.

name: blit_masked_sprite_planes
description: Draws a masked sprite row by row into four bitplanes. It reads row offsets from a record, clips the rows to horizontal limits, shifts each row by a sub-word amount, and merges four source planes with a mask into the destination words.

name: clear_table_words
description: Zeroes a block of thirty-two words in the state block and clears one more word directly after it.

name: set_flag_and_dispatch_start
description: Raises a flag word, makes a helper call, clears the flag again, stores a fixed start address in a state slot, and then calls a dispatch routine through a table.

name: service_tick_interrupt
description: Interrupt body that advances a tick counter. When a flag is clear it makes helper calls and runs a countdown loop of indirect calls, then writes the interrupt acknowledge register.

name: decode_keyboard_serial_byte
description: When a serial interrupt flag is set it reads the keyboard data register after a short busy delay, turns the code into a key number, and records the translated key in a key-state table. Keyboard layout strings are referenced for the lookup.

name: disable_audio_dma_channels
description: Writes the low four bits to the DMA control register, which clears the enable bits for the four audio channels.

name: stub_returns_immediately
description: Contains only a return instruction, so the call does no work.

name: initialise_four_audio_channels
description: Silences the four audio channels, sets their volume to zero and their period to 200, points each channel at the same sample address from the state block, calls a helper, and then re-enables DMA for those channels.

name: update_channel_volumes_from_table
description: For each of four audio channels, sets an output volume taken from an envelope table when the channel is active, using its current position and an index-driven lookup, and sets zero otherwise.

name: advance_channel_envelope_counters
description: For each of four channels with a non-zero countdown, decrements that countdown by one and increments the matching position counter.

name: short_busy_delay_loop
description: Counts a word down from six hundred to minus one with no other work, then returns its input value unchanged, so it acts as a fixed pause.

name: update_four_audio_channels
description: Refreshes four audio channels per call. When a channel's index has changed it looks up a new period and sample address from tables and restarts that channel's DMA, then moves each channel's volume toward a target by a few steps at a time.

name: return_global_value
description: Returns the value of one global byte with no other work.

name: stub_returns_immediately
description: Contains only a return instruction, so the call does no work.

name: unrecovered_ten_instruction_block
description: Facts show only ten instructions and execution entry; the decompiler timed out, so no body is available and the behaviour cannot be determined from this evidence.

name: unrecovered_single_instruction_block
description: Facts show a single instruction and execution entry; the decompiler timed out, so no body is available and the behaviour cannot be determined from this evidence.

name: stub_returns_immediately
description: Contains only a return instruction, so the call does no work.

name: stub_returns_immediately
description: Contains only a return instruction, so the call does no work.

name: stub_returns_immediately
description: Contains only a return instruction, so the call does no work.

name: stub_returns_immediately
description: Contains only a return instruction, so the call does no work.

name: copy_code_block_and_jump
description: Copies a large block of code from one address to another, patches a few jump words into fixed code locations, and then calls a routine through the supplied base at an offset. The referenced file name is not used by the visible code.

name: call_stored_handler_slot
description: Loads a pointer from the base slot, reads the routine address stored at offset eight from it, and calls that routine.

name: hang_in_endless_loop
description: Contains only an endless loop with no body, so control never leaves this routine once it is entered.

name: hang_after_beam_position_read
description: The decompiled body is only an endless loop, although the instruction facts list a read of the video beam position register. The visible code does not show what the read is used for.

name: run_main_task_loop
description: Calls the Amiga exec library to forbid task switching, then loops forever calling a sequence of routines and toggling a mode byte on each pass.

name: poll_flag_and_run_steps
description: Runs an endless loop that makes several calls, waits until a flag byte equals one, makes further calls, and then resets that flag to zero.

name: init_state_then_poll_loop
description: Sets three state bytes in sequence, then loops making calls and waiting for a flag byte to equal one before resetting it to zero and repeating.

name: run_steps_wait_on_flag
description: Makes four calls, then repeatedly makes more calls and waits for a state byte to become one before clearing it and starting again.

name: call_five_routines_then_return
description: Calls five routines in sequence and returns, with no work of its own.

name: call_five_routines_in_order
description: Calls five routines in sequence and returns, with no work of its own.

name: call_three_routines_in_order
description: Calls three routines one after another and then returns.

name: countdown_and_reset_state_byte
description: Decrements a global counter and returns while it stays non-negative. When it goes negative it reloads the counter, waits while a status bit is set if another bit is clear, and then rewrites the state byte with a fixed mask and value.

name: reset_state_byte_after_wait
description: Sets a state byte to fifteen, waits while one bit is set if another bit is clear, then rewrites the byte with a fixed mask and value.

name: store_fixed_control_words
description: Stores two fixed constant values into two hardware-related control locations. The facts identify those locations as the interrupt request and joystick port registers.

name: store_config_constants_conditionally
description: Stores a set of fixed addresses and constants into a configuration block, and when a specific byte equals a fixed character it stores five further constants.

name: unrecovered_thirteen_instruction_block
description: Facts show only the instruction count and one caller and one callee; the decompiler timed out, so the behaviour cannot be determined from this evidence.

name: service_serial_status_flag
description: When a serial status bit is set it waits briefly, clears one status bit and rotates the state byte, then sets the state byte to a fixed value and returns a longword read through a stack-supplied pointer.

name: dispatch_indirect_by_offset
description: Reads a word from a base-relative slot, adds a fixed offset, and calls the routine at the computed address. The jump table could not be recovered, so the target is not known from the code.

name: decode_joystick_direction_bits
description: Reads a joystick movement word and the fire-button state, derives four direction bits and a fire bit from fixed bit positions, and stores the combined byte back into the state.

name: scale_table_bytes_in_range
description: Walks a range of memory byte by byte, replacing each byte with a value looked up from a table at a fixed offset and shifted left by two bits.

name: build_row_address_tables
description: Loops over sixty-four entries, computing for each source word an address from its low nine bits times 160 plus a fixed base, and storing it in a table. The upper bits go into a second table, and a fixed value of 148 is written into that table for each entry.

name: measure_marker_delimited_segments
description: Scans a word table up to a marker value of 24 to find the length of the first segment, then continues to the next marker to find the second segment, and stores both lengths in the state block.

name: store_midpoint_of_two_fields
description: Computes the halfway value between two stored lengths and writes it into a field of the state block, adding the first length back in.

name: advance_segment_counter_step
description: Advances a per-segment counter by an input step in one of two modes. In the first mode, overflow past fifteen is carried into a parent counter. In the second, reaching a limit increments a segment index and resets the counter, and otherwise the step is subtracted from a shared position value.

name: step_segment_or_parent_counter
description: Subtracts a step from a shared position value once it reaches 137. Below that threshold it adds the step to a segment counter, and on overflow past fifteen it masks the counter, increments a segment index, and adds the step to a third field.

name: accumulate_with_overflow_to_parent
description: Adds a step to a counter field, and when the counter reaches sixteen or more it clamps the counter at fifteen and subtracts the overflow from a shared position value. The remaining step is then added to a second field.

name: allocate_free_record_slot
description: Scans a table of fixed-size records for the first slot whose first word is zero, initialises that record's fields from constants and reference values, marks it in use, and returns one. If no slot is free it returns zero.

name: claim_first_free_slot
description: Scans a table of fixed-size records for the first free slot, initialises its fields from constants, marks it in use and returns one, or returns zero when every slot is taken.

name: claim_free_slot_after_calls
description: Makes eight helper calls, then scans the same record table for the first free slot, initialises it from constants, marks it in use and returns one, or returns zero when none is free.

name: reset_three_linked_records
description: Sets a global value and makes a series of helper calls. For each of three records it clears the first longword and the following word, points its link field at a fixed slot, and sets a count of 44.

name: clear_two_global_bytes
description: Sets two global bytes to zero and returns.

name: dispatch_setup_through_table
description: Calls a helper, writes a fixed set of constants to global locations, then calls a routine chosen from a table by an index held in one global word. The jump table was not recovered.

name: dispatch_blit_by_stored_index
description: Writes a set of constants to blitter-related locations, then calls a routine from a table indexed by a value stored in the state block. The jump table was not recovered.

name: wait_for_blitter_then_setup
description: Waits until the blitter busy status clears, then programs a blitter operation with fixed mask, modulo and control values plus a computed pointer offset, and starts it with a size word.

name: program_blitter_with_offset
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, programs an operation with fixed masks and control words plus an offset derived from a table constant, and starts it.

name: program_multi_channel_blit
description: Waits repeatedly for the blitter to become idle, then programs a multi-channel blit with pointers, modulo values and control words derived from a computed offset, and starts it.

name: program_blit_from_record
description: Returns early when a state word equals two. Otherwise it waits for the blitter to be idle and programs a blit whose pointers and size come from fields of a record and a value derived from forty-five minus a field.

name: program_blit_from_fields
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, then programs a blit using two pointer fields read from a record and a fixed control value, and starts it.

name: step_timer_and_program_blit
description: When a state word is not two and a stored value differs from a counter, decrements a countdown and resets it when it goes negative. If a table index is valid it waits for the blitter and programs a blit with pointers taken from a table.

name: program_blit_fixed_control
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, then programs a blit using a pointer read from a record, fixed control words and a fixed size value, and starts it.

name: program_blit_from_table_entry
description: When a record index is valid, waits for the blitter to be idle and programs a blit whose source pointers come from a table entry and a record field, then starts it.

name: toggle_wait_then_blit_entry
description: Toggles a status bit until the blitter is idle, programs a blit whose source address is read from a table at a computed offset, and starts it with a fixed control value.

name: map_key_char_to_state
description: Compares a character code held in a global against three fixed codes and writes a small state value for each match, leaving the state unchanged for any other code.

name: increment_counter_with_wrap
description: Increments a global counter by one, and when it reaches a fixed ceiling it resets the counter to one instead.

name: set_global_flag_one
description: Sets a global byte to one and returns.

name: signal_and_wait_for_flag
description: Sets a global flag to one and spins until it reads back as one.

name: clear_global_byte
description: Sets a global byte to zero and returns.

name: load_table_entry_and_dispatch
description: When a global mode byte equals one, loads several fields from table entries indexed by a value, waits for the blitter, and calls a routine selected by the table. The jump table was not recovered.

name: select_state_from_flag_bits
description: When a status bit is clear, sets a state word from the first set bit of a flag byte: value one gives two, value two gives three, value four gives zero and value eight gives one.

name: select_state_from_three_flags
description: Sets a state word from the first set bit among three flag values: two gives three, four gives zero and eight gives one.

name: select_state_from_low_flags
description: Sets a state word to zero if flag value four is set, otherwise to one if flag value eight is set.

name: set_state_when_flag_eight
description: Sets a state word to one when flag value eight is set, and leaves it unchanged otherwise.

name: advance_timed_sequence_step
description: Runs a per-frame sequence step. It exits early when a state word equals a fixed value, decrements a countdown and sets a pending bit when it expires, and either starts a timed sequence or dispatches a routine through a table when a trigger bit is set. Otherwise it counts a step timer down and, on expiry, advances a 32-entry index and loads the next value from a table.

name: advance_timed_sequence_no_gate
description: Runs the same per-frame sequence step without the early exit on a state word. It decrements a countdown, starts a timed sequence or dispatches a routine through a table when a trigger bit is set, and otherwise advances a 32-entry index when its step timer expires.

name: advance_sequence_index_on_timer
description: Decrements a step timer, and when it reaches zero advances a 32-entry index, loads the next value from a table into a control field, and resets the timer to a fixed count.

name: start_or_dispatch_sequence_step
description: Checks a trigger bit and either starts a timed sequence by writing fixed values into the control block, or, when a mode bit is set, dispatches a routine through a table. Otherwise it steps the timer and index as the neighbouring routines do.

name: start_timed_sequence
description: Initialises a timed sequence by writing fixed starting values into the control block. When a table-derived position is in range it also writes a fixed word and a pointer taken from another location into a table entry.

name: select_offset_pair_by_position
description: Compares a computed position value against a fixed threshold and writes one of two fixed pairs of word offsets into two output locations.

name: store_default_offset_pair
description: Writes a fixed pair of word values into two fields of a structure addressed by an index register.

name: dispatch_frame_handler_by_position
description: Computes a table index from a state value and a position difference, loads a pointer from a lookup table, clears a control word and a flag field, then calls a routine selected by a second table lookup. The jump table was not recovered.

name: check_box_overlap_then_dispatch
description: Scans a table of six-word rectangles for one that overlaps a box formed from two position words. When one overlaps and a mode byte is zero with one flag bit set and another clear, it calls a handler through the table entry; otherwise it returns.

name: copy_four_byte_rows
description: For four records, copies a run of bytes from a source address selected by an index into a destination address. The run length comes from a record field and the copy continues until the count wraps past zero.

name: countdown_when_records_idle
description: When a mode value equals four, checks three record state words. It returns if any record is neither in state eight nor flagged. Otherwise it decrements a counter and, when that goes negative, reloads several state values.

name: clear_field_and_dispatch
description: Zeroes a word field in the state block, then calls a routine chosen by a table entry at an offset from the current state value. The jump table was not recovered.

name: reset_mode_bytes
description: Resets a group of global bytes to zero and returns.

name: dispatch_through_state_table
description: Calls a routine selected from a table by an offset based on a stored value. The jump table was not recovered.

name: dispatch_active_record_handler
description: Searches the record table for the first record whose state word equals one, then calls the handler selected by that record's table entry. Returns without calling anything if no record is active.

name: dispatch_active_record_from_pointer
description: Starting from a given record pointer, scans forward for the first record whose state word equals one and calls the handler selected by its table entry.

name: reset_record_then_dispatch
description: Makes several helper calls, stores a value into a field, clears a status bit, and then scans forward from a pointer for the first record with state one and calls the handler selected by its table entry.

name: move_record_by_direction_bits
description: Updates a record's horizontal position by four units per step according to two direction bits, and its vertical position by four according to two other bits, staying within fixed limits. It also stores the horizontal position times 200 in a global word.

name: tick_record_countdown_then_dispatch
description: Decrements a countdown word in a record and clears a flag word when it reaches zero, then scans forward for the first record whose state word equals one and calls its table-selected handler.

name: stub_returns_immediately
description: Contains only a return instruction, so the call does no work.

name: allocate_record_with_parameters
description: Finds the first free slot in a table of fixed-size records and initialises it from a table indexed by its input value and from six supplied parameters, marks it in use, and returns one. Returns zero when no slot is free.

name: deactivate_records_out_of_range
description: For each active record whose position word lies outside a fixed band, sets its state to zero and clears a word in a per-type table entry.

name: find_matching_entry_and_store
description: Scans up to twenty entries for one whose position lies inside a window around the record's position and which is active and not already claimed. It then calls a helper and stores the result in the record's claim slot.

name: scan_entries_then_store_result
description: Scans a list of entries from a current pointer for one that is active, within a horizontal window and not already claimed. It then calls a helper and stores the result in the claim slot.

name: initialise_new_entry_from_record
description: Clears the previous entry's first fields, then fills the next entry in a list with position values computed from the record's coordinates and constant offsets, marks it active, and copies two state words from the record.

name: dispatch_handler_for_overlapping_record
description: Looks for an active record of the matching state whose area, computed from table offsets, overlaps a position window. When one is found it calls the handler selected by that record's table entry.

name: dispatch_overlapping_record_from_pointer
description: From a given record pointer, scans forward for a matching record whose computed window contains the given position, then calls the handler selected by its table entry.

name: wait_for_beam_window
description: Polls the video vertical position counter and spins until its value lies inside a fixed band, then returns.

name: increment_global_counter
description: Adds one to a global counter and returns.

name: toggle_plane_pointer_table
description: Flips a one-bit global toggle and fills a table of five pointer words and five count words with one of two fixed sets, then stores a matching base value.

name: fill_toggle_table_from_base
description: Flips a global toggle bit and fills five pointer words and five count words in the table at the input address with one of two fixed sets, then stores a matching base value.

name: reset_table_to_first_set
description: Writes the first of two fixed sets of five pointer words and five count words into a table, and stores the matching base value.

name: update_active_records_per_tick
description: Decrements a global timer. Each time it expires it resets the timer and updates every active record's animation counter and pointer from table values. Otherwise it reloads a record's pointer only when its stored value has changed.

name: collect_active_records_into_list
description: Walks the record table and, for each active record not in state two, writes its screen position and table-derived values into the next free entries of a draw list, advancing the list count by two for each.

name: sort_draw_list_by_key
description: Sorts the draw list in place by its first value, swapping five parallel arrays together so each entry's fields move as one unit.

name: queue_blits_for_draw_list
description: When a global flag is set, walks the sorted draw list and clips each entry that lies in the visible window using a table. It then programs the blitter with the computed source and destination addresses, masks and size.

name: clear_two_thousand_entries
description: Zeroes a block of 2000 five-longword entries starting at a pointer held in a global.

name: clear_plane_entry_block
description: Zeroes 4096 five-longword entries starting at a fixed address.

name: set_copper_list_and_dispatch
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, loads copper list pointers from a table indexed by a value, clears a word and calls a routine selected from the table. The jump table was not recovered.

name: clear_byte_range_fixed
description: Zeroes a fixed run of bytes one at a time, from a fixed start address up to a fixed end address.

name: initialise_game_tables
description: Zeroes three tables of ten, eight and sixty-four entries, sets five records to fixed starting words, clears five hundred longwords in a large buffer, and then writes fixed values into several globals.

name: load_tables_and_clear_globals
description: Loads several words from lookup tables selected by index values into global locations, copies sixteen longwords from a source table into three destination blocks, and then clears a run of globals to zero.

name: clear_record_table
description: Zeroes the record table by writing zero to 921 longwords starting at its base.

name: cycle_background_colour_table
description: Steps a four-phase counter, and once per full cycle advances a sixty-four-step index and loads the next background colour value from a table into the colour register.

name: fade_or_copy_palette
description: When the mode byte is not one, copies a 32-word palette from a source. Otherwise it steps a fade counter and, for each of 32 colour words, reduces its red, green and blue nibbles by the current step, clamped at zero.

name: set_mode_byte_to_one
description: Sets a global byte to one and returns.

name: scale_global_with_offset
description: Adds ten to a global value, multiplies the result by four, and stores it back.

name: advance_global_index_mod64
description: Adds two to a global index and keeps it within sixty-four steps by masking it.

name: draw_rows_via_blitter_table
description: Walks a list of row descriptors and, for each row, computes a source offset from a table, waits for the blitter to be idle, and writes blitter registers from table-selected entries for each column until the counts run out.

name: program_blitter_fixed_setup
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, programs fixed mask, modulo and control values with a fixed pointer, and starts a blit with a fixed size.

name: program_blitter_offset_setup
description: Programs the blitter with fixed masks and control words and a source pointer offset from a constant, waits for it to finish, then writes its final size value to start a blit.

name: queue_pending_entry_into_slot
description: Chooses one of two slots by comparing their pointers with a limit. If the input value fits below the limit it stores that value, a word from a table and a longword from another table into the slot.

name: update_field_if_not_smaller
description: Updates a field to a new input value when that value is not smaller than the stored one, and then stores a companion word from a table and a longword into a per-type table entry.

name: store_value_at_offset_pair
description: Stores an input word at a computed offset in a record, a companion table word at a second offset, and a longword from a table into a per-type table entry.

name: build_pointer_table_from_scan
description: Scans a table of bytes for the entry that ends a rising run, then fills thirty-one pointer words in a block selected by that value and sets several global control values.

name: advance_audio_frame_and_pointers
description: Advances a frame counter, and on each frame reloads the four audio channel location pointers from a table after a short delay. It then advances a per-frame position value and steps a block of entries until it passes a fixed limit.

name: process_channel_effect_tick
description: Runs one tick of a channel effect for a tracker-style sound player. It reads the effect nibble of the current command and, depending on it, slides the period up or down, steps through a table of periods, modulates the period, or handles extended codes, then writes the channel's period register.

name: start_channel_note_from_row
description: Reads the next pattern entry for one channel of a tracker-style sound player. When an instrument number is present it loads that instrument's sample address, length and volume and computes the starting period, then handles the row's effect command and writes the channel's location and length registers when a sample starts.

name: advance_channel_effect_tick
description: Runs the per-tick effect for one channel of the tracker-style sound player. It handles the same effect nibbles as its sibling routine, adjusting the channel period and volume, and returns the new period. Extended effect codes are dispatched separately.

name: copy_record_word_field
description: Copies a word from one field of a record into a field of an output block.

name: look_up_period_for_note
description: Finds the first entry in a per-instrument period table whose value is at least the record's current period, applies a direction-dependent step, and stores the matching period in a target field. It sets a flag when the target lies below the current period.

name: slide_period_toward_target
description: When a slide is active, moves the stored period toward its target by a per-tick step, up or down depending on a direction flag, and stops at the target. It then looks up a period from a table using the low nibble of a control byte and writes the result to the output.

name: apply_vibrato_offset
description: Computes a modulation offset for one channel from a waveform table, using a phase counter and a depth nibble, adds it to the channel's period, and advances the phase by a speed nibble. The waveform type selects a table, a ramp or a square shape.

name: process_channel_command_effect
description: Dispatches one channel command nibble for the tracker-style sound player. It handles a sample offset, a position jump, a pattern break, volume and speed changes, and extended commands, updating channel fields and returning the value the caller writes to the channel.

name: store_low_nibble_field
description: Copies the low four bits of a command byte into a nibble field of a record.

name: shift_buffer_rows_by_offset
description: Shifts a buffer of rows by one row length of 120 bytes using a stored offset. It stages the first block in a temporary area and writes it back at the new position.

name: decode_backreference_stream
description: Decodes a compressed bit stream. Each step reads a flag bit and either copies one literal byte or copies a run of earlier output bytes whose length and distance come from fixed tables and extra bits, writing backward until the output pointer passes its limit.

name: short_spin_delay
description: Counts a short word down from three to minus one with no other work, then returns, so it acts as a brief pause.

name: check_bit_buffer_then_return
description: Tests a bit buffer for emptiness and a low flag bit, then returns in every case without changing any state.

name: shift_bits_from_stream
description: Shifts the next bit out of a bit buffer, reloading the buffer from the previous longword of the stream when it empties. The step repeats for the count held in the input register.

name: toggle_bits_in_bytes

name: update_bit_flags_in_memory
description: Applies bit-level updates to several memory bytes and words, clearing or setting single bits chosen by register bit numbers, and adds a constant to a word. The decompiled tail is undecodable data and is not described.

name: unrecovered_bad_data_block

name: dispatch_channel_command_value
description: Dispatches one channel command nibble for the tracker-style sound player and returns a value for the caller. It updates channel fields for each command, such as sample offset, position jump, volume and speed.

name: reload_audio_pointers_and_advance
description: Waits briefly, latches a status word into a global, reloads the four audio channel location pointers from a table, and clears the pending flag when set. It then advances a per-frame position value and steps a block of entries until it passes a fixed limit.

name: lookup_table_value_by_mod3
description: Selects a column of a per-instrument table from a counter taken modulo three, then scans for the first entry at least as large as the record's current value and stores that entry in the output.

name: lookup_table_entry_by_nibble
description: Scans a per-instrument table for the first entry at least as large as the record's current value and stores the entry in the column given by the low nibble of a command byte.

name: copy_current_value_to_output
description: Copies the record's current value word into the output field.

name: lookup_table_entry_by_index
description: Scans a per-instrument table for the first entry at least as large as the record's current value, then stores the entry at the column given by an input index into the output.

name: store_input_word_to_output
description: Stores a word supplied in a register into an output field.
